seoDescription: Free online AGY CPA to JSON Generator — ATools (Pure Tools). Convert email----password--------client_id----refresh_token account lines into Antigravity client JSON config files in bulk, named automatically as antigravity-<email>.json with refresh_token, project_id, expires_in, timestamp and type fields filled in. Copy or download each file, or export everything as a single ZIP, with optional pretty printing. 100% free, no sign-up: everything runs locally in your browser and nothing is ever uploaded — perfect for managing multiple AGY account configs.
keywords: free online AGY CPA to JSON generator
